notes.title: Update log about archives and other game optimizations
notes.content:
At around 12 o'clock in the morning last night, we released the game on STEAM as soon as possible on the occasion of New Year's Eve.

I received some player feedback today. In order to provide players with a better experience, some small details have been optimized and adjusted. An update was made this afternoon. Players in the community and those who have already played can feel it.
 
Then, after the game is updated, some players may find that the archive is missing. In fact, the archive is still there, but we have changed the path. Let me tell you how to restore the archive.
 
Before restoring the archive, please turn on "Hidden Options" in File Explorer


The recovery method is as follows
 
1. Old archive path

C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\Ghost Road Game Studio\Underworld Awakening\Utage\Ghost Road

 
2. New archive path

C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\Ghost Road Game Studio\GhostRoad\SaveProject

 
3. Find the archive file, copy it to the new archive folder, and change the original archive file name "wake up" to "save"

4. Re-enter the game to restore the original save! You're done!



In addition, we have also fixed the problem that the BGM volume becomes smaller when dubbing occurs, and we will adjust the volume of dubbing later.

There are also some other minor issues that do not affect the overall game play and experience.

In terms of UI buttons, players also pointed out that the semi-hidden buttons affect the operation. If they want to make them clearer, they will be adjusted in the future.


If you encounter problems, please join our official community: 873326647

notes.title: Awakening from the Underworld will be officially launched on STEAM on New Year
notes.content:
"Ghost Road: Underworld Awakening", developed and produced by Ghost Road Game Studio and published by Luna Infinity Games, will be officially released on Steam on January 1, 2024. This version supports both Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese Chinese.

This is a visual novel game about ancient Chinese myths and legends. It uses the ghost stories of the underworld as the background theme and combines a large number of allusions from "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" and folklore. On this basis, it is presented to players in the form of fictional creations.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/DgJ0m1f/12-31-1.jpg[/img]

The player will take on the role of a soul-gatherer from the underworld. Just after returning to the underworld from traveling in the human world, Luo Xiaoyan (Little King of Hell) arranges a difficult task to investigate the rampage of the grudge cage on the Wangchuan River. From this moment on, you will experience the completely different pasts of the three heroines. You will learn about the stories that happened to the heroines by possessing others, traveling through past lives, and recalling them. You will also reveal your true identity.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/n3rC8fk/12-31-3.jpg[/img]

Gameplay

This game adopts a multi-line and multi-ending approach. There are a large number of options in the game for players to make interactive choices. The options are mainly divided into three types: "main line", "plot" and "ending".

Main line options: For example, Su Mei’s three main lines, Lu Xiaojia, Jin Dashuai, and Ahua, respectively tell different stories about these three people and Su Mei. Players can have a more complete understanding of the character of Su Mei after completing these three lines. and all that happened to her;

Plot options: This type of options will not affect the occurrence of the plot, but are just choices of different mood options;

Ending options: will directly affect the occurrence of different endings. If you choose the wrong one, you may not see the perfect ending of complete awakening.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/64QnqHP/12-31.jpg[/img]

Game features

Chinese mythology and ghost themed game, a rare visual novel independent game with an underworld theme as the background, don’t miss it
An original script of more than 200,000 words was created with great care, telling the legends of the underworld, the human world, the demon world and the Qingqiu Fox Clan.
There are more than ten CV dubbing actors, the dubbing is very distinctive, including loli, royal sister, girl and Sichuan dialect, etc.
More than ten OST original music productions, using a large number of traditional Chinese instruments, such as: suona, erhu, guzheng, Xiao, flute and Chinese drum, etc., with strong national characteristics, each BGM is in line with the game scene and story theme, shocking audio-visual enjoyment
Four female protagonists and more than ten NPC characters, three main stories and a side story of Po Meng, with multiple endings for each character
Art features, the original painting design is inspired by the water and land painting form of ancient Chinese Taoism, and combined with the modern popular two-dimensional painting style. A large number of underworld scenes: Fengdu Ghost City, Ghost Gate, Wangchuan River, Flower Sea on the other side, Rakshasa Ghost Market, etc.

notes.title: Ghost Road: Awakening from the underworld: Demo version has been launched
notes.content:
About the demo version

In this demo version, we have opened one of the lines for the female lead Su Mei, with a full voice acting gameplay time of about 2 hours and a script of about 33000 words.

Recently, we have also added some illustrations and optimized the UI, and all character dubbing work has been completed.

Plot introduction:
The player plays the role of the Soul Detainer in the underworld. As soon as they return from a business trip in the human world, they are assigned a very tricky task by the Little Yanluo King, which requires them to resolve the rampage of the resentful cage on the Forgotten River. During the process of rescuing the resentful cage Su Mei, the player will travel back to her past through the Rebirth Mirror, attach themselves to other NPCs, experience her tragic experiences, understand her obsession, and help her find ways to escape.

notes.title: Game Development Update Log for Ghost Road
notes.content:
Hello, dear STEAM players, everyone!

I have been very busy lately and often work overtime until late at night because there are also many players and supporters in some game communities and forums, and I often need to answer their questions in the middle of the night. Alright, without further ado, let me now report the overall progress of the project to everyone.

🎨 fine arts
We have recently added a few illustrations and expressions of the female lead, as well as vertical illustrations, to make the game presentation more diverse.
All scene designs have been completed, and some minor optimizations have been made, such as adding roads and shadows to the details in Buzhou Mountain.

🎤 dubbing
We have completed the re recording and editing of the voices of Youying and Meimei, as well as the additional recording of several characters. Except for Lianyue, all characters and NPC dubbing have been completed. This means that in the game, except for the voiceover and players, all 20 characters have dubbing, with over 5000 lines of dubbing and over 200000 words of script. The entire gameplay time is 6-7 hours, and this scale of dubbing is unparalleled in domestic visual novel games!

🎹 music
The original background music for the game OST, as of yesterday, the last song "Burial of Demons" has been fully produced. I can say that all the music is excellent, and every piece of music is very charming when listened carefully. We would like to thank our arrangement teacher for their efforts!

🌈 Game GUI
Today we have updated another version of the design, which is more exquisite than before, more in line with the theme and characteristics of the game. We have added mouse icons, optimized the game start interface, and added different states of buttons to enhance the game's design sense

💻 program
The program and testing are our main tasks in the future, including updating and replacing many resources, submitting new requirements, providing testing feedback, and optimizing bugs, all of which require the program to complete. Basically, each of our development team members will participate in testing work, propose their own optimization suggestions and requirements, and then the program will make corresponding adjustments based on feedback.

📢 The above is a summary report of all current research and development work.

We will announce the launch date of the demo in the near future, and everyone can also follow it!
I hope everyone can actively participate in the demo version testing when the time comes. 
There will definitely be some shortcomings, and I hope everyone can give us positive feedback without hesitation!

notes.title: Ghost Road: Awakening from the unde development log update 002
R&D Log Update 001 for 'Ghost Road: Awakening from the underworld'
"Awakening from the Underworld" is available on the STEAM store interface!
notes.content:
💻After more than a year of intense research and development, we are very happy that our independently developed visual novel game "Kidō: Underworld Awakening" is finally available to everyone. The game has just been approved and put on the STEAM store page. Currently, a lot of work is still in progress.

📖Themes: Adventure, Visual Novel, Rich Plot, Folklore, Underworld
Theme: The main line of this work tells the story of the three lives of the nine-tailed fox demon in Qingqiu. The player plays the role of the underworld soul keeper who will experience three completely different storylines of the three female protagonists. As the story deepens, a person hidden in the underworld will A shocking secret will eventually surface...
Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio 1:
A cage of resentment floats on the Forgotten River, and the singing girl has deep obsessions in her heart.
This is an extremely tragic story, telling the love and hatred between the singer Su Mei and Lu Xiaojia, Jin Dashuai and Ahua.
Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio 2:
The memory seal on the Sansheng Stone is causing trouble in the Da'an Dynasty.
This is a dynasty full of monsters and monsters. As a princess, should you choose power or love?

Strange Tales from the Chinese Studio 3: There is a beast in Qingqiu Mountain, and a nine-tailed fox fairy descends to the earth.
In ancient times, a Qingqiu spirit fox who had practiced cultivation for thousands of years had just transformed into a beautiful girl. Who knew that she would wait for thousands of years for a true love!

🎨The original painting design is inspired by the ancient Chinese Taoist water and land painting form, and is combined with the modern popular two-dimensional painting style. Some props in the scene are inspired by ancient Chinese cultural relics. Referring to the literature records about the eighteen levels of hell and the underworld in ancient books, from Fengdu Ghost City to Guimen Pass, to Huangquan Road, Naihe Bridge, Wangchuan River, etc., it completely displays a "panoramic view of the underworld", with each scene The atmosphere shows the eerie, strange and bizarre nature of hell.

🎧The original OST music uses a large number of traditional Chinese instruments, such as suona, erhu, guzheng, xiao, flute and Chinese drum, etc., which has strong national characteristics. The music type is mainly based on ancient Chinese tunes, and a large number of pentatonic scales are used: Gong, Shang, Jiao, Zheng, Yu and Virginia's medieval modes, etc., making the expression of the music rich and full. The background music production process was combined with the picture design of the underworld scenes, such as adding the sound effects of flowing rivers to the Wangchuan River and Naihe Bridge, and adding sound effects samples of ghost howls in Fengdu Ghost City and Rakshasa Ghost City. The layers are distinct and enhance the entire game. sense of atmosphere.
🎙Full audio CV dubbing, more than ten professional CV voice actors, and Douyin dubbing internet celebrities with more than 5 million fans have joined.

🌈Game features:
1. Chinese mythology, underworld, and ghost-themed games
2. Original script of 200,000 words. Any similarity is purely coincidental.
3. Three heroines and more than ten NPC characters, multiple story lines and multiple endings
